name: lambda-normalization-census
description: A reproducible, dependency-free engine and open dataset classifying closed untyped lambda-terms (de Bruijn natural size, OEIS A275057) as strongly normalizing (SN), weakly-but-not-strongly normalizing / separating (SEP), or non-normalizing (NWN / UND). Exact enumeration for small sizes; Monte-Carlo sampling beyond. Includes a companion Barendregt-Geuvers-Klop conservation lab, autoresearch training artifacts, and the separator-density curve.

distribution.name: census_dataset.csv
distribution.description: Exact + Monte-Carlo normalization census for closed λ-terms by de Bruijn natural size. One row per (size, method) pair.

distribution.name: census_dataset.json
distribution.description: Same census data as JSON (list of records, same schema).

distribution.name: bgk_lab_results.json
distribution.description: Barendregt-Geuvers-Klop conservation conjecture experiment results: checked combinators, witness terms, and conservation status.

recordSet.name: census_records
recordSet.description: Normalization statistics per λ-term size and enumeration method.

field.name: n
field.description: De Bruijn natural size of the closed λ-terms enumerated.

field.name: total
field.description: Total number of closed λ-terms of size n examined.

field.name: SEP
field.description: Count of weakly-but-not-strongly normalizing / separating terms.

field.name: UND
field.description: Count of undecided terms (computation timed out).

field.name: decided
field.description: Count of terms with a definitive classification (SN + SEP + NWN).

field.name: dens_SN_of_total
field.description: SN density over all examined terms (SN / total).

field.name: dens_SN_of_decided
field.description: SN density over decided terms only (SN / decided).

field.name: dens_SEP_of_decided
field.description: SEP density over decided terms (SEP / decided).
